technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring for Apache Kafka to implement Kafka-based data pipeline in XD.
Use Spring Batch and Spring Integration to implement Sqoop-based batch samples.
Modify Gradle build scripts to remove documentation generation tasks and link rewriting.
Create Storm and Spark Streaming example comparisons using Spring XD modules.
Port Smart Grid demo from s1-2014 into Spring XD samples repository.
Implement JDBC to HDFS data movement using Spring Integration or Spring Batch.
Add --nameExpression option to file sink for flexible file naming in stream definitions.
assumptions: Developer has prior experience with Spring XD, Kafka, Sqoop, Storm, and Spark Streaming.
All required dependencies and libraries are available or can be resolved via standard repositories.
Testing will be performed manually or via existing test frameworks without additional setup.
Documentation updates are minimal and handled within code comments or inline documentation.
No external infrastructure setup is required beyond standard development environment.

activities.activity_description: Build a data pipeline using Kafka as a message bus in Spring XD, including log aggregation, lambda architecture, and reliable reprocessing capabilities.
Create a batch sample using Sqoop to demonstrate JDBC to HDFS and HDFS to JDBC data movement.
Modify Gradle scripts to remove documentation generation tasks, pushGeneratedDocs task, and link rewriting logic.
Develop a comparison of Storm examples in Spring XD to help field engineers relate implementations.
Develop a comparison of Spark Streaming examples in Spring XD to help field engineers relate implementations.
Port the Smart Grid demo from s1-2014 into the Spring XD samples repository.
Create an example demonstrating JDBC to HDFS data movement.

activities.activity_name: Add File Sink Name Expression Option
activities.activity_description: Add --nameExpression option to file sink for flexible file naming in stream definitions.
